description: This image presents a donut chart, a variation of a pie chart, illustrating the distribution of different categories under the central bolded heading "Stimulus Type." The chart is divided into 10 distinct slices. There is no separate legend; instead, category labels and their corresponding exact percentages are positioned outside the chart, adjacent to their respective slices. Moving clockwise from the top right, the segments include: a dark red slice for "Draft/Other" (26.4%), a dark brown slice for "Event Posting" (6.6%), a purplish-grey slice for "Organizational Report" (7.7%), a greyish-purple slice for "Organizational Website" (4.9%), a dark blue-grey slice for "Interview" (8.8%), a blue-grey slice for "Intra-agency news article" (4.9%), a dark green-grey slice for "External News Article" (18.1%), a light green-grey slice for "Email" (2.7%), an olive green slice for "Press Release" (18.7%), and a thin light brown slice for "Social Media Post" (1.1%). The segments do not appear to be ordered by size, such as in a strictly ascending or descending manner. None of the individual slices are exploded, offset, or otherwise visually emphasized beyond the central title.
